question: The Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus is a prime example of which of the following types of architectural style?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indo-Saracenic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indo-Saracenic style** is an architectural style that emerged during the British colonial era in India, blending **Indian, Islamic, and Gothic architectural elements.**
 
• The **Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus**, formerly known as Victoria Terminus, is an iconic railway station in **Mumbai, Maharashtra.**
